339-677-969-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-969-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4247-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4247-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-3249-3755--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1303-3249-3755--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-6835-8095.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-6835-8095.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

3234-3293-4247-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4247-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4247-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

654-2557-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1778-3558-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3558-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1263-2511-4871-5075.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7157.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

11-5864-6070-7089.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
You control at least two Doctors.
11-5864-6070-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting and returning the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

3532-5078-6556-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-5078-6556-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

997-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-6701--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

4681-5686-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

1339-6092-6096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6092-6096.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
The Locust God triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve a trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-2438-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2438-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

891-2511-2523-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2511-2523-5515.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-3259-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1753-3259-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1365-2034-2744-4404.notablePrerequisites: Corridor Monitor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2034-2744-4404.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
When Corridor Monitor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

224-1359-2366-4050-5258.notablePrerequisites: You are abile to play a land this turn.
224-1359-2366-4050-5258.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {B}.
Activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger from step 2, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Dryad Arbor on top of your library.
Galadriel's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal Dryad Arbor from the top of your library, and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

3141-4067.notablePrerequisites:
Jace's Archivist does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
A player has at least three cards in hand.
3141-4067.description:
Activate any mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Jace's Archivist by paying {U} and tapping it, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping Jace's Archivist and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

186-411-2510-4720.notablePrerequisites: Any creature exiled by Semblance Anvil.
186-411-2510-4720.description:
Pay {R} to return Grinning Ignus to your hand, adding {R}{C}{C}.
Cast Grinning Ignus for {R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast for {C} to add {R} leaving you where you started with with an additional {1}.
Repeat for infinite mana.
